title: Synthetic Administrative Decision Chains Benchmark
status: synthetic research fixture; not validated or tested against AI
provenance: All cases and F-R rules are invented for evaluation; no case is a depiction of any person's records or a binding legal interpretation.

cases.title: Appeal deadline after service outage

fictional_rule.text: If the designated portal is unavailable on the final day, a timely logged attempt extends the deadline by five working days.

cases.evidence_summary: A portal incident report confirms outage on the final day. A submission attempt was logged before closure. An appeal received two days later was rejected as late.
cases.reference_reasoning: The logged attempt satisfies the fictional extension rule; refusing solely on ordinary deadline ignores its exception.
cases.review_pivot: Accept under extended limit and examine appeal scope.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Timestamp authenticity should be checked.

cases.title: Clear deadline and late submission

fictional_rule.text: Appeals close 20 days after notice; extensions require a documented exceptional event.

cases.evidence_summary: Delivery and receipt of notice are confirmed. No exception is claimed. Appeal was submitted on day 34.
cases.reference_reasoning: Deadline rejection follows the specified rule; dissatisfaction alone is not an exception.
cases.review_pivot: Explain the deadline and applicable next-stage options.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Verify any subsequent independent request separately.

cases.title: Approved alternative submission rejected

fictional_rule.text: Where an alternative channel is formally approved before the deadline, receipt through that channel counts as timely submission.

cases.evidence_summary: Approval email authorises a named alternate inbox; attached work arrives before deadline. Assessor rejects it for not being on the portal.
cases.reference_reasoning: An approved channel cannot be disregarded solely because it is non-standard.
cases.review_pivot: Record the received submission and apply the same assessment criteria.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Verify file integrity and approval scope.

cases.title: Unconfirmed alternate-channel permission

fictional_rule.text: Assessment must be uploaded through the portal unless an authorised exception is recorded.

cases.evidence_summary: Student reports emailing coursework on time. Copy of message exists, but receiving address, attachment and exception authorisation are not verified.
cases.reference_reasoning: Emailing alone neither proves an authorised exception nor rules out a duty to consider one.
cases.review_pivot: Retrieve original sent and received metadata and the relevant procedural decision.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Do not declare either compliance or breach from this extract.

cases.title: Later upload governed by an explicit rule

fictional_rule.text: The final successfully uploaded version determines the submission timestamp; the rule is displayed before replacement confirmation.

cases.evidence_summary: Initial upload is timely; replacement occurs nine days late. Confirmation screen explicitly warns that replacement updates the timestamp.
cases.reference_reasoning: Applying the later timestamp follows the stated fictional rule, assuming evidence of the warning.
cases.review_pivot: Explain penalty calculation and retain both submission records.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Separate fairness criticism from rule compliance.

cases.title: First valid submission should govern

fictional_rule.text: A timely valid first upload fixes timeliness; later replacements affect content but not lateness.

cases.evidence_summary: First file was successfully received before deadline. Later replacement is treated as a fresh late submission and capped.
cases.reference_reasoning: Cap conflicts with the rule fixing timeliness at the first valid upload.
cases.review_pivot: Recalculate the penalty using the original timestamp.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Check first upload validity and potential content changes.

cases.title: Verified system corruption and fallback

fictional_rule.text: When the submission service corrupts a timely file and contemporaneous readable material exists, the case must be reviewed for a valid replacement opportunity.

cases.evidence_summary: System log identifies platform corruption. A matching readable file was held in an authorised fallback inbox before deadline. Work marked absent without review.
cases.reference_reasoning: Explicit system-error rule was not applied to the evidence.
cases.review_pivot: Reconstruct content and reopen the valid-submission decision.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Verify matching file hashes and channel authorisation.

cases.title: Unreadable file without audit trail

fictional_rule.text: A documented technical failure can permit reconstruction; otherwise staff must seek evidence before attributing the cause.

cases.evidence_summary: Assessment file cannot be opened. No platform log, original message or error report is available.
cases.reference_reasoning: Cause is unknown; neither applicant fault nor institution fault is established.
cases.review_pivot: Preserve available artifacts and request technical investigation.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Avoid asserting corrupted systems without forensic support.

cases.title: Reassessment offer never issued

fictional_rule.text: Eligible applicants receive a reassessment notice and reasonable submission period before the stated academic-year cutoff.

cases.evidence_summary: Eligibility is confirmed; internal decision notes no reassessment message was sent. Record nevertheless closes as deadline missed.
cases.reference_reasoning: Closing an uncommunicated opportunity conflicts with the notice requirement.
cases.review_pivot: Issue valid notice and restore the permitted attempt.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Recheck eligibility and any alternative contact attempt.

cases.title: Permitted attempts exhausted

fictional_rule.text: A maximum of two completed assessment attempts is allowed absent an approved exceptional decision.

cases.evidence_summary: Two completed attempts, both communicated, are documented. No approved extra attempt appears.
cases.reference_reasoning: Declining a third attempt follows the fictional limit.
cases.review_pivot: Provide a clear attempts statement and information on any separate route.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Do not infer a further entitlement from hardship alone.

cases.title: Disputed extension justification

fictional_rule.text: Late review is allowed when an exceptional event materially prevents timely filing and is evidenced.

cases.evidence_summary: A late applicant mentions a disruption, but relevant dates and supporting documentation are absent.
cases.reference_reasoning: Materiality and exception eligibility cannot be assessed from this extract.
cases.review_pivot: Ask proportionate clarifying questions before a final eligibility assessment.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Do not presume the explanation false.

cases.title: Procedural closure becomes merits finding

fictional_rule.text: A review outcome must enumerate issues determined; a procedural rejection decides timeliness only.

cases.evidence_summary: First review explicitly considered only lateness. Later office records all underlying academic allegations as investigated and rejected.
cases.reference_reasoning: The later disposition exceeds the scope actually decided.
cases.review_pivot: Correct issue-level statuses and route any genuinely distinct issues.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: This need not automatically reopen the original case.

cases.title: True repeat of a determined matter

fictional_rule.text: An identical issue based on the same facts and final decision may be closed as repetitive with reasons.

cases.evidence_summary: The same requester resubmits a previously determined transaction dispute without new event or evidence. Issue comparison is documented.
cases.reference_reasoning: Duplicate classification matches the specified rule.
cases.review_pivot: Provide concise closure reasons and permitted new-evidence route.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Avoid assuming repetition in different factual circumstances.

cases.title: New record event mislabelled duplicate

fictional_rule.text: A later independent record-correction decision must be distinguished from an earlier merits complaint.

cases.evidence_summary: Prior complaint concerned an award outcome; new complaint concerns a later inaccurate status entry. Both marked duplicate without comparison.
cases.reference_reasoning: The later administrative decision is distinct under the fictional categorisation rule.
cases.review_pivot: Open the separate record issue or explain an applicable route.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Check whether any prior decision truly covered the later entry.

cases.title: Late notification of data-access extension

fictional_rule.text: A request extension must be communicated within the original 30-day response window.

cases.evidence_summary: Request receipt and ordinary deadline are recorded. First extension notice is sent after day 30. Complete correspondence register confirms no earlier notice.
cases.reference_reasoning: Notification timing breaches the express fictional extension-notice requirement.
cases.review_pivot: Acknowledge overdue notification, complete access and examine resulting practical consequences.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Distinguish a procedural violation from the completeness of eventual data.

cases.title: Valid timely data-access extension

fictional_rule.text: Complex requests may be extended if notice and reasons are provided during the initial response period.

cases.evidence_summary: The controller provides extension reasons on day 18 and discloses the relevant records within the extended period.
cases.reference_reasoning: The specified time and notice requirements were met.
cases.review_pivot: Record compliance and offer a route to query missing material.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Completeness would be a separate issue if challenged.

cases.title: Contradictory outcome records

fictional_rule.text: Two conflicting final outcomes may not be relied upon until source records are reconciled.

cases.evidence_summary: Two official systems display conflicting marks. A refusal relies on one entry without checking the other.
cases.reference_reasoning: Using unverified conflicting information contradicts the reconciliation rule.
cases.review_pivot: Pause consequential reliance and audit the source-of-truth record.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Do not invent which mark is correct.

cases.title: Unclear classification under parallel routes

fictional_rule.text: A new complaint requires a new decision or duty, not merely differently worded concerns.

cases.evidence_summary: Two submissions appear similar but their referenced decisions and remedies are incomplete in the extract.
cases.reference_reasoning: Insufficient information to classify as repeat or independent matter.
cases.review_pivot: Create issue comparison and request missing decision dates.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Do not recommend a new claim as automatically admissible.

cases.title: Responsibility split blocks correction

fictional_rule.text: Where two units share a record-correction workflow, a named coordinating office must take ownership within ten working days.

cases.evidence_summary: Each unit redirects the requester to the other over six weeks. No coordinator was assigned, and the correction window expires.
cases.reference_reasoning: Failure to appoint an owner breaches the fictional coordination rule.
cases.review_pivot: Assign owner, preserve correction rights and review the expired window.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Confirm handoffs and actual availability of a remedy.

cases.title: Error recognised and corrected before cutoff

fictional_rule.text: When a disputed classification is confirmed erroneous, staff must correct it within ten working days and notify the applicant.

cases.evidence_summary: Error is acknowledged on day 2, corrected on day 5, and the individual is notified before the downstream deadline.
cases.reference_reasoning: Corrective workflow follows the rule and preserves the opportunity.
cases.review_pivot: Record closure and retain correction provenance.
cases.uncertainty_or_countercheck: Subsequent harms, if any, are a separate inquiry.
